title: concise-marketplace-value-snippets-and-ops-gate-list
summary: Working draft: short, A/B-friendly marketplace tile/title/descriptions + operator readiness gates checklist. Focus on voice variants for SMB vs. Enterprise and a compact ops acceptance list for launch.
content:
Purpose
This doc is a compact, shareable set of marketplace copy snippets (tile titles, one-line value props, 3-line descriptions, CTAs) plus an ops gate checklist that the listing owner and partner success team can run through before publication. Intended to be copy-first and lightweight — use as a source of truth for testing copy variants and for quick preflight checks.

Notes on scope and audience
- Audience: marketplace listing reviewers, partner managers, content designers, product marketing.
- Scope: copy for catalog tile, short descriptive bullets, primary CTA variants, two pricing blurbs (trial + commit), micro-UX hints (trial badge, telemetry opt-in).
- Status: draft. Need legal review for claims and data residency statements (see linked_artifacts).

Tile title variants (short, 20-40 characters)
1) "Redwood Inference API — predictable, fast"
2) "Managed LLM inference (hosted + private)"
3) "Low-latency LLM serving — pay per use"
4) "Redwood: production-grade model serving"
Notes: prefer 1 or 4 for broad audience; 2 is more explicit for technical buyers. Keep <40 chars for most marketplaces.

One-line value propositions (for hero/short description) (<=110 chars)
A) "Run LLMs at predictable cost and latency — hosted, dedicated, or on-prem deployments with built-in fallbacks."
B) "High-throughput, low-latency inference with autoscaling, KV caching, and model rollouts."
C) "Ship LLM features faster: unified API, observability, and cost controls for production workloads."
Recommendation: A for general marketplace tile; B for technical audiences; C for PM / product-focused pages.

Three-line expanded description (for full listing)
- Variant 1 (SMB-friendly): "Redwood Inference provides a simple API for text generation, embeddings, and chat. Start with hosted endpoints and scale to dedicated or private deployments as your traffic grows. Built-in tooling helps you control cost, monitor latency, and roll out model versions safely."
- Variant 2 (Enterprise/tech): "A production-grade inference platform tuned for throughput and reliability. Dedicated GPU pools, VPC/private control plane, and integrated telemetry let platform teams meet SLAs while optimizing unit economics across models and hardware."

Bulleted capability snippets (3 bullets, short)
- "Streaming responses, function calling, and structured outputs"
- "Autoscaling + reserved capacity for predictable throughput"
- "Token-level cost and latency breakdowns in Console"

CTA variations (choose 1 primary + 1 secondary)
Primary: "Start free trial" | "Get started — free credits" | "Request a demo"
Secondary: "View docs" | "See performance benchmarks" | "Contact sales"
Guidance: use "Start free trial" for self-serve-ready listings; "Request a demo" when product requires sales-assisted setup (Dedicated/Private).

Pricing blurbs (short)
- Trial-focused (SMB): "Free trial with $500 credits — pay-as-you-go after. No long-term commitments."
- Commit-focused (Enterprise): "Reserve Dedicated capacity with monthly commits. Contact sales for sizing and SLA options."
Legal/residency note (placeholder text to be validated by legal): "Data processed by Redwood Inference is isolated per-tenant; for Private deployments, customers retain control of keys and logs. See DPA and region-specific terms."

Micro-UX copy / badges / telemetry hints
- Trial badge: "Free trial — $500 credits" (placed on tile)
- Show a small performance badge for verified models: "Verified: <10ms avg token latency*" (only with validated telemetry)
- Checkbox copy for telemetry opt-in: "Share anonymized performance traces to help improve model routing (optional)"

Acceptance & ops gate checklist (quick yes/no + owner actions)
1) Copy & claims review completed (marketing + legal) — owner: Aisha (Y/N) — action: consolidate final hero line.
2) Security & compliance gating: data residency statement approved? — owner: Sofia (Y/N) — action: attach DPA link.
3) Pricing SKU mapped to marketplace catalog — owner: Marcus (Y/N) — action: confirm SKU ids and trial credits.
4) Technical integration smoke test: listing tile link routes to correct quickstart + working API key for trial sign-up — owner: Devon (Y/N) — action: run signup end-to-end.
5) Observability snippet: console links and trial telemetry are wired (docs + sample dashboards) — owner: Platform eng (Y/N) — action: add dashboard links to listing.
6) Fallback & runtime claims validated: model variants + fallback policy documented — owner: Applied ML (Y/N) — action: include short note in listing FAQ.
7) Partner/ISV co-branding assets uploaded (logos, hero image, terms) — owner: Partner Ops (Y/N) — action: verify asset sizes and licensing.
8) Accessibility & localization checks for target regions (EN + key locales) — owner: Localization (Y/N) — action: provide translations for title and one-line prop.
9) Final QA / smoke: sample request completes within latency SLO for typical prompt — owner: SRE (Y/N) — action: attach runbook link.

Decision tree for CTA selection (quick)
- Is listing self-serve (trial sign-up fully automated)? -> Yes: CTA = "Start free trial". -> No: CTA = "Request a demo".
- Does the offering include reserved capacity / custom SLA? -> If yes, make "Contact sales" visible and mark listing as sales-assisted.

Risk & mitigation notes (short)
- Risk: Overpromising latency numbers from newer models. Mitigation: only publish measured metrics with date and test harness link.
- Risk: Stale legal copy on data residency. Mitigation: hold launch until legal attaches DPA and region clauses.
- Risk: Broken trial onboarding path. Mitigation: manual E2E smoke by dev + product owner prior to publish.

Open questions / TODOs
- Which 2 models should we show as "verified" on the tile? (action: Applied ML to propose list and measured numbers)
- Confirm exact trial credit amount and expiration window for partner promo codes (action: Finance + Partner Ops).
- Decide whether to surface a short SLA statement on the tile (Y/N).

Owner playbook (publish day checklist)
- 24 hours before: confirm asset pipeline (logos, hero image), confirm SKU mapping in marketplace portal, finalize title/one-liner.
- 2 hours before: final smoke test of signup flow, confirm telemetry link, attach DPA link if required.
- Publish: click publish, record listing id, post in #marketplace-launch Slack channel with checklist and owner.
- Post-publish (24–72h): monitor signups, latency/err rates, and any rejection feedback from marketplace moderation.

Notes to reviewers
Please comment inline with preferred hero line (A/B) and mark yes/no on each ops gate. If you have an alternate tile title that is shorter and punchier, add as a new line. Legal: please flag any claim that requires rewording (ex: specific latency numbers, residency commitments).

Draft history
- 2024-11-02: initial draft by Aisha Patel
- 2024-11-06: added CTA decision tree + ops gates (Marcus Lee)
